metadata.dataset_name: Curated Amazon Clothing Benchmark (16x20 Research Sample)
metadata.dataset_version: 16x20 Curated Research Slice (based on UCSD He & McAuley WWW 2016 schema)
metadata.citation: R. He, J. McAuley. Ups and downs: Modeling the visual evolution of fashion trends with one-class collaborative filtering. WWW 2016.
metadata.disclaimer: Curated 16-user x 20-item research sample adhering to Julian McAuley's Amazon Clothing 5-core schema. Designed for reproducible, zero-cost CPU demonstration, not the full 278,677 review dataset.
